focus.product: OCTG premium-connection threading and tubular accessories (finish-threaded casing/tubing, couplings, pup joints, cross-overs)
focus.why: Batam already holds a one-product cluster: Kabil hosts Citra Tubindo, Telaga Mas Mulia (36,000 t/yr), Servotech and APPIPA, and SIINas lists Rainbow Tubulars, Hydril (Tenaris), Hunting, Precision Pipe and NOV's H-Tech in Kepri. Indonesia imported US$169.9M of casing/tubing (730429) in 2025 (Comtrade), down from US$347.9M in 2023; exports were US$126.7M in 2025.

National mould imports were US$214.0M in 2025 (848071). Fixtures suit 3D printing; Polibatam already runs 3D printers.

also.why: Kepri's official 2010 designation is ships and ship parts (KBLI 30113); 55 shipbuilders and 23 ship repairers are registered; Batam's UMSK covers shipyards. Ship propeller imports: US$27.7M (2025).
